overall_summary: Neither material task outcome can be determined from the captured evidence. The executor was blocked by cluster expiration before obtaining discovery output, and every after-executor observation was unavailable. The mandatory node-restart protocol was also not performed or evidenced.

The sole executor command ended with cluster_expired and produced no managed-node observations.

Baseline package-manager health was already unavailable due to timeout, and final package health was also unavailable.

The only executor command was read-only discovery and did not reach the node because its cluster lease had expired; therefore no state-changing executor command requires attribution.
